# Third-party decoders (tests only)

Independent decoders the tests use to check that Maqam Studio's own encoders
write files other software reads. None of this is linked into the app.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `minimp3.h` | https://github.com/lieff/minimp3 | CC0 1.0 (public domain) |
| `dr_flac.h`, `dr_wav.h` | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | Public domain (Unlicense) or MIT No Attribution |

`tools/make_mp3_tables.py` also reads `minimp3.h` to derive the MP3 encoder's
Huffman codes and filter-bank window, which ISO/IEC 11172-3 fixes; the result
is checked into `Core/src/mp3_tables.cpp` and regenerated by CI to prove it
still matches.
